# PR1212 original Darwin Process and Stage1 results

## Source and evidence boundary

All four jobs belong to the original pull_request attempt 1 opened on 2026-11-16 at 05:11:13UTC for frozen Draft PR1212. Their API head and successful checkout are exactly 3a81d8bfb72b2f21a2bca1c0b1d8cf24fc61cc6d / tree 3f5eaa85f44a8c35f3dec9b06e6ecb2bf2fab6ac. Process run 43808579933 and Stage1 run 43808579939 remain the original cohorts; no edited event, rerun or prior source has been substituted. The retained run-level API status still says queued while the full jobs APIs report these terminal jobs; this discrepancy is retained as returned.

The full original four job logs are preserved without ANSI/BOM/newline rewriting. Full run/jobs API bodies and all returned first-page artifact metadata are retained. The child verified each artifact's ID, name, size, digest and run/source against its original upload log and API; the child did not download, extract, CRC-check or inspect any archive member. Artifact metadata is not archive-byte verification.

## Process Darwin success, with finite scope

Darwin ARM job 133104905716 completed SUCCESS at 05:36:55UTC; Darwin x64 job 133104905922 completed SUCCESS at 05:29:55UTC. Each actually ran Node 24.21.0 and the original build sequence under set -euo pipefail: task-change-ledger TypeScript, controller build, Host production TypeScript, full Host TEST TypeScript, owned-process-broker TypeScript and retained-host TypeScript. The following step actually executed, so these compiler successes are supported by command order and step completion, not inferred only from whole-job success.

Each then reports:
- Original Host contracts: 167 tests, 165 PASS, 2 SKIP, 0 FAIL/cancel/todo.
- Original complete broker protocol configuration: 3 files, 53 PASS.
- Original retained Main eight-file invocation: 8 files, 81 PASS.
- Original two POSIX Node/shell lifecycle files: 27 PASS, 0 SKIP/FAIL.
- Total reported test invocations: 328, 326 PASS, 2 SKIP, 0 FAIL/cancel/todo.

The two contract skips are the Linux existing/linked-output compiler-dispatch refusal case and the Linux signed-Node/unsigned-native inode comparison case. These are platform skips, preserved exactly. Windows native Job/source-A/B stages 11–21 are skipped by this Darwin route. The source's final scope writer explicitly leaves nativeProviderRuntimeQualified, darwinNativeRegistrationQualified, posixExecutableAdmissionQualified, desktopQualified and releaseQualified false; the successful verifier step is not an original Windows 15-second or Desktop qualification. The actual scope JSON archive remains unread by this child.

Artifact joins:
- ARM14200441792:12,976 bytes; SHA2561971683a87e972ed98d6f9477bac358f9414915d8eccc9da3e13bdea7d893173.
- x6414200635299:13,245 bytes; SHA256ac6dbac69721337ff1a1348f8e9352b262126441fa24ba9b7a73c322c6ad9f2f.

## Stage1 Darwin: successful prerequisites followed by original P09 failures

Both original Stage1 jobs reached the existing POSIX original-path test at step 24. Both preceding graph/custody tests report 57 PASS/1 SKIP of 58, the earlier executable-custody invocation reports 1 PASS/1 SKIP of 2, private Desktop recipe composition reports 1 PASS, and the native original Host manual-flow test reports 1 PASS. The later POSIX invocation reports 0 PASS/1 FAIL, 0 SKIP/cancel/todo. Thus each job's reported invocation census is 63 tests: 60 PASS,1 FAIL, 2 SKIP. The two skips are the Linux builder case and the POSIX case during the earlier executable-custody invocation when that route is not yet enabled; the later original POSIX invocation does execute and fail. Earlier actual Host/custody success cannot promote the whole Stage1 job or P09.

All failure assertions join the unchanged frozen source packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-executable.native.ts, blob f1e1d1145898e201723be343fa8768d73332fcb1. The original loop retains case observations and failures while continuing other cases; multiple diagnostics are not separate overall test invocations.

### ARM133104905851

The first retained mutation diagnostic is adhoc-test-only:after-check at 05:38:46.711767UTC, followed by writer-open at 05:38:46.817550UTC. Both original rows report errno 0, execErrno 0, stoppedBeforeUser=true, payloadMarkersAbsentBeforeGate=true, kernelImageObserved=true, imageMatched=true, resumed=true and mutationAfterCheckErrno 0. Both report exitCode 0, exitSignal 0, originalReaped=true, originalGroupAbsent=true, cleanup=true and three A markers: library, constructorA and mainA; constructorB/mainB are false. The failed original assertion at source 496:24 requires an empty marker string after this successful byte mutation. Actual is 'LIB\\nBIN:A\\nMAIN:A\\n', expected empty. This job does not report the x64 compiler-default kernel-signature failure.

The whole job failed at 05:38:54UTC. Artifact14201110244 is10,479 bytes with SHA256605290ab76be196f034484432d718022435d0bb2dbdec28011c03c7ddaba2bb6.

### x64133104905856

The first original failure diagnostic at 05:30:27.181905UTC is compiler-default:baseline, stage kernel-image-validity, errno 13 and codeSigningError −67062. The final surfaced original assertion is source 476:18, 13 !== 0. Later retained after-check and writer-open rows separately report the same successful mutation/A-marker behavior as ARM with errno 0, mutationAfterCheckErrno 0 and cleanuptrue. These later rows do not erase the earlier baseline failure, and the baseline code-signing value does not explain away the distinct successful-mutation marker failures.

The whole job failed at 05:30:52UTC. Artifact14199819136 is10,564 bytes with SHA256460fb4072c738adc52d722a3f766ac61032a91462422beb93e47e0420dae1fc4.

## Limits and next evidence

The diagnostics support these exact observed failure boundaries; they do not establish a new kernel mechanism, safe oracle change, performance cause or deadline correction. All original assertions and artifacts remain intact. Root owns any actual archive-byte/member review. No source/test/workflow, deadline, retry, native command, ref, PR, cancellation or rerun was created by this evidence collection.

The previously retained five Windows jobs failed checkout before these builds/tests/native stages. Their documentary long-path failures remain separate. Process Linux and four Stage1 jobs were still queued in the 05:42:15UTC jobs snapshot and are not qualified by these Darwin results.
